bibliographic.title: Open Adventure
bibliographic.author: William Crowther, Don Woods, Eric S. Raymond and contributors; Inform 6 / Z-machine port by Craig Daters
bibliographic.headline: Inform 6 / Z-machine port of ESR Open Adventure / Adventure 2.5 / 430-point lineage
bibliographic.description: This metadata describes the Open Adventure Inform 6 / Z-machine port artifact and TerpVault package candidate. The IFID belongs to this port artifact, not to the original Crowther/Woods Adventure, ESR's native C source, the 350-point version, the 550-point version, or another historical build. Intended port source repository: https://github.com/cdaters/open-adventure-inform
